g.text: Objective: turn one company's stored rows into the figures the screen judges it on: region, tax rate, ratios and market cap in US dollars.
back to the screen board

text.tspan: the company is in the companies table
every company of companies is screened
its rows are loaded
its non-restated financials_annual rows, oldest first (latest row = newest fiscal year)
newest prices_daily close and newest market cap, each from its own newest non-empty row
its valuation currency is read
valuation currency = currency of the newest non-restated financials_annual row
its Damodaran dataset region is set
China, India, Japan: their own dataset
else the country's grouping in its newest damodaran_country row, mapped to a dataset region (e.g. Western Europe → Europe)
no country, or an unknown grouping: US
its tax rate is set
newest damodaran_country tax rate of the country, when within [0, 1)
else 21%

g.text: its ratios are computed

text.tspan: its market cap is in US dollars (USD), or empty
market cap in USD = market cap × rate_to_usd of its listing currency, the rate on or before the market-cap date (from currencies)
no rate: empty, so min_market_cap fails
no listing currency: taken as USD

g.text: its sector benchmark is looked up
companies
financials_annual
prices_daily
damodaran_country
currencies

text.tspan: Comes out:
one company snapshot: ratios and histories, market cap in USD or empty, region, tax rate, valuation currency, Damodaran industry or none

g.text: terms: return on equity (ROE), return on invested capital (ROIC), earnings per share (EPS), book value (BV), enterprise value (EV), earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT), earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA).
net debt = total debt − cash; a missing term counts as 0; both missing: empty
ROE = net income ÷ total equity
EPS = net income ÷ diluted shares
price-to-earnings P/E = close ÷ EPS, only when EPS > 0
BV per share = total equity ÷ diluted shares
price-to-book-value P/BV = close ÷ BV per share, only when > 0
EV ÷ EBITDA = (market cap + net debt) ÷ EBITDA
ROIC = EBIT × (1 − tax) ÷ (total debt + total equity); a missing term counts as 0; both missing: empty
free cash flow yield = free cash flow ÷ market cap
operating margin = EBIT ÷ revenue, per year
Histories (revenue, operating cash flow, diluted shares, operating margin) drop empty years.
Otherwise a missing input leaves the ratio empty.
the screen loads its rows [it has a Damodaran industry]
the screen loads its rows [it has no Damodaran industry]
the screen reads its valuation currency [it is in config/currencies.yaml]
the screen reads its valuation currency [missing, or not in config/currencies.yaml]
the region is its own dataset [China, India or Japan]

text.tspan: the region maps from its country's grouping [a known grouping]
the grouping is mapped to a dataset region, e.g. Western Europe → Europe

g.text: the region is US [no country, or an unknown grouping]

text.tspan: the tax rate is its country's [a Damodaran rate within 0 to 1]
the rate is taken when 0 ≤ rate < 1

g.text: the tax rate is 21% [no country rate, or one out of range]
the screen computes its ratios from the newest row and the histories

text.tspan: the market cap is converted to US dollars (USD) [a rate on or before its date, or no listing currency or date]
market cap in USD = market cap × rate_to_usd

g.text: the market cap stays empty [no market cap, or no rate to USD]
the screen finds the newest sector benchmark row [it has a weighted average cost of capital (WACC)]
the screen finds a sector benchmark row [its WACC is empty]
the screen finds no sector benchmark row [none for the industry and region]
every company
annual rows
newest close and newest market cap
country mapping
country tax rate
rate_to_usd
the snapshot goes on to the coverage gate [always: every company is looked up]
